scripts.check: npm run htmlvalidate && npm run stylelint && npm run prettier
scripts.fix: npm run htmlvalidate:fix && npm run stylelint:fix && npm run prettier:fix
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && html-minifier-next src/webb/index.html -o dist/index.html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-optional-tags --remove-redundant-attributes --use-short-doctype --minify-css true && cleancss -o dist/styles.css src/webb/styles.css
